messages:
SRE Bot: ALERT: routing-churn-high detected on smart-router (score=94) across regions us-east / us-west / eu. Auto-page to oncall.
PagerDuty: Pager duty escalation to @Anna (oncall) — ACK required :bell:
Anna: acknowledging, taking pager. Investigating now. Saw spike in route changes and KV cache evictions.
Mike: looking at metrics — network egress is fine but we’re seeing health-check flip rate high on the probe manager. probes toggling 1s -> 0ms states.
Eva: noticed a config pushed 2024-12-17T12:03Z by mike@infra: `smart-fallback-v2` changed: failure_threshold=1, health_check_interval=1s, prioritized_regions=[us-east,us-west,eu]
Anna: that seems aggressive — with 1s interval and threshold=1 a single transient miss will flip region. That matches the oscillation pattern.
Dan: confirmed log tail from probe-manager (snippet):
```
2024-12-17T12:18:03Z probe(us-east): PASS
2024-12-17T12:18:04Z probe(us-east): FAIL (timeout)
2024-12-17T12:18:05Z route: promote(us-west)
2024-12-17T12:18:06Z probe(us-west): PASS
2024-12-17T12:18:07Z probe(us-west): FAIL (k8s node transient)
2024-12-17T12:18:08Z route: promote(eu)
```
Anna: that's the zig-zag — each fail causes immediate failover, then the next region takes load, warms KV cache, then flaps back. customers see 5xx and latency spikes.
Gina: product reporting increased error rate for EU customers on /v1/generate: baseline 0.7% -> 27% at peak, P95 latency x2.3. Several high-volume customers reported degraded UX.
Anna: mitigation plan — freeze routing policy to sticky mode to stop promotions, increase probe debounce, and revert the aggressive change. Steps:
  1) lock policy `smart-fallback-v2` to sticky (no automatic promotions)
  2) revert failure_threshold to 3 and health_check_interval to 5s
  3) bump probe debounce to 30s
  4) monitor error-rate and traffic distribution
Mike: running command to lock policy: `rwctl routing lock --policy smart-fallback-v2 --mode sticky --reason "mitigate zigzag"` — applying now.
SRE Bot: rwctl ack: lock applied by mike@infra at 2024-12-17T12:22Z :white_check_mark:
Anna: reverting config change (cli): `rwctl routing update --policy smart-fallback-v2 --failure-threshold 3 --health-interval 5s` — patch applied, pushing to control-plane.
Dan: deploying probe debounce patch to probe-manager: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/probe-manager PROBE_DEBOUNCE=30s` — rolling restart queued.
Eva: watchers: shifting to sticky reduced route changes from 120/min to 4/min within 90s. Error-rate started dropping (EU /v1/generate 27% -> 3.2% in 10m)
Gina: customer comms: sent initial note to affected customers and CS with ETA to stable: 45m. Incident severity elevated to SEV2 due to customer impact.
Anna: monitoring telemetry — KV cache hit-rate stabilizing, region load rebalanced. Still watching for residual thrash as caches warm.
Mike: root cause hypothesis: an infra config change made fallback too sensitive (failure_threshold=1 + 1s checks) which combined with transient node flakiness created a feedback loop across prioritized regions. Also routing promoted hottest region which caused further instability.
Anna: next actions before closing:
  - create rollback PR to make sensible defaults and add guardrails (rate limit promotions)
  - add alert that flags >5 route promotions/min
  - include postmortem owner: Mike (infra)
  - schedule follow-up with QA and SRE to add integration tests for debounce behavior
Dan: noted. Patch PR opened: https://git.internal/r/infrastructure/pulls/412 — includes default thresholds and promotion-rate limiter.
PagerDuty: incident acknowledged and marked: acknowledged_by=Anna, status=mitigated -> monitoring
SRE Bot: RESOLUTION: sticky lock + config revert + probe debounce applied. Observed metrics stable for 30m. Recommend postmortem and follow-up action items.
Anna: handing off to oncall secondary (Dan) for night watch, I'll draft postmortem. If anything spikes, page me back :phone:
Dan: taking handoff. Thanks everyone — good coordination. :handshake:
Gina: logging customer impact summary for PMs and CS: peak 27% errors EU, ~18 customer accounts affected, mitigated within 30m.
Mike: assigning postmortem to infra and SRE, will include timeline and config patch. Thanks team.
SRE Bot: closing alert: routing-churn-high cleared at 2024-12-17T13:12Z. :tada:
